html:
Unique Research · Insight · January 10, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub · Interviews: Gravity Ventures Indigo; FancyTech CBO Moyu; peers

Hook. Jason Allen’s Midjourney + PS Théâtre D’opéra Spatial wins Colorado State Fair digital-art prize (≈100 gens + weeks of fine-tune) → Getty bans AI art over unclear IP. Debate: does AI ruin art? ConTech / content mid-platform / DAM already hot; AIGC now rewires content marketing at scale.

Indigo (N.America lens): US tech cos dominate foundation LLMs — language as human–machine interface that can then emit image/video/audio. China stronger on pattern recognition (vision/video/text analysis) via data scale. Jasper / Runway / Copy.ai already sketch the commercial map.

Commercial shifts. (1) Free basic cognitive labor — tell AI what you want; Stable Diffusion-class open models remix humanity’s semantic corpus into scenes. (2) Cut creative headcount once output is stabilized (still human-heavy now) — AI imagination can surprise. Marketing uses: copy, social posts, ads, blog SEO, creative variants at volume, DAM enrichment.

Named vendors. Copy.ai (GPT-3 175B; social/titles/link desc/blog ideas). Jasper ($125M Series A; 25+ languages; 50k actives; >6B words generated; plans from $24/mo / 20k words). Runway ($50M Series C Dec 5, 2018-founded; New Balance / Hollywood; CEO Cristóbal Valenzuela). China sample: FancyTech Content Hub (cross-platform hit reuse + gen); Chopstick-class creative SaaS; more named in CN §05.

Financing / thesis. CB Insights-style concentration; Microsoft–OpenAI $1B as 2019 spike. For marketers: treat AIGC as production-mode upgrade inside ConTech/DAM stacks, not a toy — provenance, IP, and labeling still open risks.

Full vendor + deal tables in CN — attach on ingest.

— END —
